diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: The vendors give only the nominal rail (Hobby Components HC3DPR0015: 'Supply Voltage: 5V Sensor: TCST2103'; Botland: 'V: 5 V supply'), not a maximum; the board has no regulator, so V only drives the TCST2103 LED through 180 Ohm and the 2.2 kOhm pull-up, and at 5.5 V the LED draws about (5.5 - 1.25)/180 = 24 mA against the Vishay rating 'Forward current IF 60 mA' while the phototransistor is rated 'Collector emitter voltage VCEO 70 V', so 5.5 V (5 V +10%) is a safe conservative ceiling and the second reading simply copied the nominal 5 V.
